content.comment_body: Hello everyone, The [product_name] CPU with article number [article_no] has been discontinued as of 10/10/2018. Is there an available model that directly replaces it? Thank you,

The currently available [product_name] (12/24 RCE) model is article number [article_no]. For this device, you'll need [product_name] software version [version_no]. Older versions of the software can be updated for free: you can download the [product_name] software upgrade, but note that the download is subject to export restrictions. Registration and login are required—what information is needed for this registration process?

Hi, How do I switch from [article_no] to its successor module? Could you share a reference link or instructions to guide the upgrade? Additionally, do I need to replace the old expansion modules when upgrading from [article_no] to [article_no]? Are the older expansion modules still compatible with the new model? Thanks in advance.

Previous expansion modules are not compatible with the newer [product_name] series ([version_no]). Starting from [version_no] released in 09/2014, new expansion modules were introduced to match the updated devices. The article numbers for these new expansion modules are: [IMAGE] To upgrade to the latest model: Download the upgrade (see link above) and install it. You can open previous [product_name] software files with [product_name] version [version_no]. Simply switch the device selection from your older CPU to the current one.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking information about successor models and upgrade procedures for a discontinued [company_name] [product_name] controller. They are requesting guidance on software upgrade steps, compatibility issues with expansion modules, and the process for accessing restricted software downloads. The main concern is ensuring hardware and software transitions are smooth and that information regarding compatibility is clearly communicated.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a clear and compatible replacement product, straightforward upgrade instructions, backward compatibility with existing hardware, and uncomplicated access to necessary upgrade software.
